quarterly_data.signal: Sigurd 1Q26 results (investor conference deck, 06-23-2026): consolidated revenue NT$5.29 billion (NT$5,294 million), up 13.0% YoY and a record quarterly high; gross margin 31.7% (1Q25: 28.5%); operating income NT$1,184 million (22.4% margin); net income NT$1.12 billion, up 29.3% YoY; EPS NT$2.10. January-May 2026 revenue NT$9,216M, up 17.5% YoY (January-May 2025: NT$7,845M). Memory products represented approximately 10% of consolidated revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: 1Q26 revenue NT$5.29 billion (+13.0% YoY, record); EPS NT$2.10; Jan-May 2026 revenue NT$9,216M (+17.5% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Operational outlook (company): although 2Q26 revenue growth may face short-term pressure from rising memory prices, demand remains strong across AI servers, ASIC, AI Connectivity, silicon photonics, networking ICs and memory, and capacity expansion with new equipment gradually coming online is expected to support future revenue growth. For 2H26, Sigurd expects growth momentum from AI servers, ASIC, AI Connectivity, SiPh, networking ICs, LEO satellites, memory and silicon capacitors.

In May 2026 Sigurd's board approved additional capex of NT$2.822 billion, bringing full-year capex to NT$8.8 billion, up approximately 48% from the original plan; the group's capital expenditure is estimated to reach NT$18.6 billion. The additional investment targets rising testing demand from AI servers, ASIC, AI Connectivity, silicon photonics, networking ICs, silicon capacitors and 2nm flagship 5G Agentic AI chips.
quarterly_data.figure: additional capex NT$2.822 billion; full-year capex NT$8.8 billion (~48% above original plan); group capex estimated NT$18.6 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Hukou Plant II (two basement floors and six above-ground floors, total building area 28,107.66 square meters): cleanroom renovation is progressing and the new capacity has already been reserved by an important overseas customer (not named); with advanced equipment arriving, the plant is expected to enter mass production in 2H 2026, helping to ease capacity constraints and fulfill customer demand.
quarterly_data.figure: 28,107.66 square meters; capacity reserved by an overseas customer; mass production expected 2H 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Chungshing Plant III (two basement floors and seven above-ground floors, total floor area 36,340 square meters): construction is expected to be completed ahead of schedule in Q4 2026, with mass production planned for Q1 2027; the plant targets AI, ASIC, AI Connectivity and automotive IC testing.
quarterly_data.figure: 36,340 square meters; completion Q4 2026; mass production planned Q1 2027

quarterly_data.signal: AI Connectivity test platform (company): Sigurd describes a high-speed optoelectronic test platform bridging NPI verification to high-volume manufacturing, covering EIC PAM4 112G / 224G test, 200G VCSEL / PD LIV, NF and RF test, PIC and optical-engine auto-alignment opto-electrical test, BERT and TDECQ test, and massive KGD parallel optical test, plus a new advanced SiPh lab facility; its in-house RF SoC test platform (MAP) is being enhanced for 224Gbps SiPh TIA and driver and SiPh PIC / OE (optical engine) testing.
quarterly_data.figure: PAM4 112G / 224G; 200G VCSEL / PD; 224Gbps SiPh TIA and driver
